    async function applyOtaUpdatePayload(rawPayload, versionLabel = null, broadcastToCloud = true, publishRelease = false, releaseNotes = '') {
      if (!rawPayload || !String(rawPayload).trim()) return false;
      const text = String(rawPayload).trim();
      let targetHtml = null;
      let targetVersion = (versionLabel || ('OTA-' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('es-UY'))).replace(/^v/i, '');

      if (text.startsWith('{')) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
          if (parsed.version) targetVersion = String(parsed.version).replace(/^v/i, '').trim();
          if ((parsed.css || parsed.js) && !parsed.html) {
            if (parsed.css) localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_LIVE_CSS', parsed.css);
            if (parsed.js) localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_LIVE_JS', parsed.js);
            localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_VERSION_TAG', targetVersion);
            localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_LAST_DATE', new Date().toLocaleString('es-UY'));
            loadLivePatches();
            ui.otaStatusMsg = `✅ Parche v${targetVersion} aplicado en vivo.`;
            spawnFloatingBurst(`🏷️ Release v${targetVersion}`, true);
            if (publishRelease && cleanRepoSlug() && getActiveGitHubToken()) {
              await publishGitHubRelease(text, targetVersion, releaseNotes || `Parche OTA v${targetVersion}`);
            }
            render();
            return true;
          }
          if (parsed.html && (parsed.html.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>') || parsed.html.includes('<html'))) {
            targetHtml = parsed.html;
          }
        } catch (err) {
          ui.otaStatusMsg = '❌ Error al leer el bloque JSON OTA.';
          render();
          return false;
        }
      } else if (text.includes('<!DOCTYPE html>') || text.includes('<html')) {
        targetHtml = text;
        const verMatch = text.match(/APP_BASE_VERSION\s*=\s*['"]([^'"]+)['"]/);
        if (!versionLabel && verMatch && verMatch[1]) targetVersion = verMatch[1].replace(/^v/i, '');
      }

      if (targetHtml) {
        localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_CUSTOM_HTML', targetHtml);
        localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_VERSION_TAG', targetVersion);
        localStorage.setItem('KRONO_OTA_LAST_DATE', new Date().toLocaleString('es-UY'));
        state.lastReleaseTag = 'v' + targetVersion;
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
        ui.otaStatusMsg = `✅ Release v${targetVersion} instalado. Reiniciando...`;
        spawnFloatingBurst(`🏷️ Release v${targetVersion}`, true);
        if (publishRelease && cleanRepoSlug() && getActiveGitHubToken()) {
          await publishGitHubRelease(targetHtml, targetVersion, releaseNotes || `Release OTA Krono Finanzas v${targetVersion}`);
        }
        if (syncChannel) syncChannel.postMessage({ type: 'OTA_APPLIED' });
        setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 650);
        return true;
      }

      ui.otaStatusMsg = '⚠️ Formato OTA no reconocido. Pegá un JSON {"version","html"} o HTML completo.';
      render();
      return false;
    }

    async function fetchPayloadForReleaseTag(repo, releaseObj) {
      const tagName = releaseObj.tag_name || (state.githubBranch || 'main');
      const filePath = (state.githubFilePath || 'ota.json').trim().replace(/^\/+/, '') || 'ota.json';
      const candidates = [filePath, 'ota.json', 'index.html'];

      for (const file of candidates) {
        try {
          const apiUrl = `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/contents/${file}?ref=${encodeURIComponent(tagName)}&t=${Date.now()}`;
          const res = await fetch(apiUrl, { headers: getGitHubHeaders(), cache: 'no-store' });
          if (res.ok) {
            const meta = await res.json();
            if (meta && meta.content) {
              return decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(meta.content.replace(/\s/g, ''))));
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        try {
          const rawUrl = `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${repo}/${encodeURIComponent(tagName)}/${file}?t=${Date.now()}`;
          const rawRes = await fetch(rawUrl, { cache: 'no-store' });
          if (rawRes.ok) return await rawRes.text();
        } catch (e) {}
      }
      return '';
    }

      const repo = cleanRepoSlug();
      if (!repo) return false;
      ui.otaChecking = true;
      if (manual) { ui.otaStatusMsg = `🔍 Consultando último Release en GitHub (${repo})...`; render(); }

      try {
        const endpoint = state.githubIncludePrereleases
          ? `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases?per_page=5&t=${Date.now()}`
          : `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases/latest?t=${Date.now()}`;
        const relRes = await fetch(endpoint, { headers: getGitHubHeaders(), cache: 'no-store' });

        if (!relRes.ok) {
          ui.otaChecking = false;
          if (relRes.status === 404 && manual && getActiveGitHubToken()) {
            return await publishGitHubRelease();
          }
          return false;
        }

        const relData = await relRes.json();
        const latestRelease = Array.isArray(relData) ? relData[0] : relData;
        if (!latestRelease || !latestRelease.tag_name) {
          ui.otaChecking = false;
          return false;
        }

        const remoteTag = String(latestRelease.tag_name).trim();
        const remoteVer = remoteTag.replace(/^v/i, '');

        state.lastReleaseNotes = latestRelease.body || latestRelease.name || '';
        state.lastGithubSync = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-UY', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    async function pushSingleFileToGitHub(repo, branch, path, contentStr, commitMsg, token) {
      const apiUrl = `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/contents/${path}`;
      const headers = {
        'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json',
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      };
      let existingSha = null;
      try {
        const getRes = await fetch(`${apiUrl}?ref=${encodeURIComponent(branch)}&t=${Date.now()}`, { headers, cache: 'no-store' });
        if (getRes.ok) {
          const getJson = await getRes.json();
          if (getJson && getJson.sha) existingSha = getJson.sha;
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      const safeContent = sanitizeHtmlForGitHubUpload(contentStr);
      const base64Content = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(safeContent)));
      const bodyObj = { message: commitMsg, content: base64Content, branch };
      if (existingSha) bodyObj.sha = existingSha;

      const putRes = await fetch(apiUrl, { method: 'PUT', headers, body: JSON.stringify(bodyObj) });
      if (!putRes.ok) {
        const errData = await putRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.message || ('Error al subir ' + path + ': HTTP ' + putRes.status));
      }
      return await putRes.json();
    }

    async function publishGitHubRelease(rawHtmlOrJson = null, versionTag = null, customNotes = '') {
      const repo = cleanRepoSlug();
      const token = getActiveGitHubToken();
      let branch = (state.githubBranch || 'main').trim() || 'main';
      const otaPath = (state.githubFilePath || 'ota.json').trim().replace(/^\/+/, '') || 'ota.json';

      if (!repo || !token) return false;

      ui.githubPushing = true;
      ui.otaStatusMsg = `🏷️ Subiendo actualización a ${repo}...`;
      render();

      try {
        const headers = {
          'Accept': 'application/vnd.github.v3+json',
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        };

        try {
          const repoRes = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}?t=${Date.now()}`, { headers, cache: 'no-store' });
          if (repoRes.ok) {
            const repoMeta = await repoRes.json();
            if (repoMeta && repoMeta.default_branch) {
              branch = repoMeta.default_branch;
              state.githubBranch = branch;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        const ver = (versionTag || getCurrentInstalledVersion()).replace(/^v/i, '');
        const tagName = 'v' + ver;
        let currentHtml = localStorage.getItem('KRONO_OTA_CUSTOM_HTML') || ('<!DOCTYPE html>' + document.documentElement.outerHTML);
        if (rawHtmlOrJson) {
          const trimmed = String(rawHtmlOrJson).trim();
          if (trimmed.startsWith('{')) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed);
            if (parsed.html) currentHtml = parsed.html;
          } else if (trimmed.includes('<html')) {
            currentHtml = trimmed;
          }
        }
        currentHtml = sanitizeHtmlForGitHubUpload(currentHtml);

        const otaJsonPayload = JSON.stringify({ version: ver, html: currentHtml }, null, 2);
        await pushSingleFileToGitHub(repo, branch, otaPath, otaJsonPayload, `🏷️ Krono Finanzas Release ${tagName} (${otaPath})`, token);
        await pushSingleFileToGitHub(repo, branch, 'index.html', currentHtml, `🏷️ Krono Finanzas Release ${tagName} (index.html)`, token);
        await pushStateToGitHubCloud(false);

        const notes = customNotes || ui.releaseNotesInput || `Release oficial Krono Finanzas ${tagName}: Método Mix (Inteligencia personalizada + Google Tasks Bridge).`;

        let existingReleaseId = null;
        try {
          const checkRel = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases/tags/${encodeURIComponent(tagName)}?t=${Date.now()}`, { headers, cache: 'no-store' });
          if (checkRel.ok) {
            const relJson = await checkRel.json();
            if (relJson && relJson.id) existingReleaseId = relJson.id;
          }
        } catch (e) {}

        const releasePayload = {
          tag_name: tagName,
          target_commitish: branch,
          name: `Krono Finanzas ${tagName}`,
          body: notes,
          draft: false,
          prerelease: false
        };

        const relUrl = existingReleaseId
          ? `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases/${existingReleaseId}`
          : `https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases`;
        const relMethod = existingReleaseId ? 'PATCH' : 'POST';

        const relRes = await fetch(relUrl, { method: relMethod, headers, body: JSON.stringify(releasePayload) });
        if (!relRes.ok) {
          const errData = await relRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
          throw new Error(errData.message || ('Error creando Release HTTP ' + relRes.status));
        }

        localStorage.setItem('KRONO_AUTO_DEPLOYED_VER', ver);
        state.lastReleaseTag = tagName;
        state.lastReleaseNotes = notes;
        state.lastGithubSync = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-UY', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
        ui.githubPushing = false;
        ui.otaStatusMsg = `✅ Release ${tagName} publicado en GitHub.`;
        spawnFloatingBurst(`🏷️ Subido ${tagName} a GitHub`, true);
        render();
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        ui.githubPushing = false;
        ui.otaStatusMsg = `❌ Error al publicar en ${repo}: ${e.message}`;
        render();
        return false;
      }
    }

    function getTotals() {
      const rate = Number(state.exchangeRate) || 41.5;
      let totalUYU = 0, monthIncomeUYU = 0, monthExpenseUYU = 0;
      state.accounts.forEach(acc => { totalUYU += acc.currency === 'USD' ? acc.balance * rate : acc.balance; });
      state.transactions.forEach(tx => {
        const valUYU = tx.currency === 'USD' ? tx.amount * rate : tx.amount;
        if (tx.type === 'income') monthIncomeUYU += valUYU; else monthExpenseUYU += valUYU;
      });
      return {
        totalUYU,
        totalUSD: totalUYU / rate,
        monthIncomeUYU,
        monthExpenseUYU,
        savingsRate: monthIncomeUYU > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.round(((monthIncomeUYU - monthExpenseUYU) / monthIncomeUYU) * 100)) : 0
      };
    }

    function formatMoney(amount, currency = 'UYU') {
      return (currency === 'USD' ? 'US$ ' : '$ ') + Number(amount || 0).toLocaleString('es-UY', { maximumFractionDigits: currency === 'USD' ? 2 : 0 });
    }

    function addTransaction({ title, amount, currency = 'UYU', type = 'expense', category = 'Comida y Súper', accountId = null, fromExternal = false }) {
      const numAmount = Math.abs(Number(amount) || 0);
      if (numAmount <= 0) return null;
      let targetAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === accountId) || state.accounts[0];
      if (targetAcc) {
        const delta = type === 'income' ? numAmount : -numAmount;
        if (targetAcc.currency === currency) targetAcc.balance += delta;
        else if (currency === 'USD' && targetAcc.currency === 'UYU') targetAcc.balance += delta * state.exchangeRate;
        else if (currency === 'UYU' && targetAcc.currency === 'USD') targetAcc.balance += delta / state.exchangeRate;
      }
      const now = new Date();
      const newTx = {
        id: 'tx_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000),
        title: (fromExternal ? '🤖 ' : '') + (title || 'Transacción'),
        amount: numAmount,
        currency,
        type,
        category,
        accountId: targetAcc ? targetAcc.id : 'acc_uyu',
        accountName: targetAcc ? targetAcc.name : 'Cuenta Principal',
        date: `${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}/${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')} ${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      };
      state.transactions.unshift(newTx);
      spawnFloatingBurst(`${type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}${formatMoney(numAmount, currency)} (${targetAcc ? targetAcc.name.split(' ')[0] : ''})`, type === 'income');
      saveState(true, true);
      return newTx;
    }

    }

    function normalizeStr(str) {
      return String(str || '').toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
    }

    function extractSmartAmount(segText) {
      let s = normalizeStr(segText)
        .replace(/\bun\s+mil\b/g, '1000')
        .replace(/\bdos\s+mil\b/g, '2000')
        .replace(/\btres\s+mil\b/g, '3000')
        .replace(/\bcuatro\s+mil\b/g, '4000')
        .replace(/\bcinco\s+mil\b/g, '5000')
        .replace(/\bdiez\s+mil\b/g, '10000')
        .replace(/\bquince\s+mil\b/g, '15000')
        .replace(/\bveinte\s+mil\b/g, '20000')
        .replace(/\bquinientos\b/g, '500')
        .replace(/\bseiscientos\b/g, '600')
        .replace(/\bsetecientos\b/g, '700')
        .replace(/\bochocientos\b/g, '800')
        .replace(/\bnovecientos\b/g, '900')
        .replace(/\bcien\b/g, '100')
        .replace(/\bdoscientos\b/g, '200')
        .replace(/\btrescientos\b/g, '300')
        .replace(/\bcuatrocientos\b/g, '400');

      const numMatch = s.match(/(\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{3})+(?:,\d+)?|\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)/);
      if (!numMatch) {
        if (/\bmil\b/.test(s)) return 1000;
        return 0;
      }

      let rawNum = numMatch[1];
      if (/^\d{1,3}(\.\d{3})+$/.test(rawNum)) {
        rawNum = rawNum.replace(/\./g, '');
      } else if (rawNum.includes('.') && rawNum.includes(',')) {
        rawNum = rawNum.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.');
      } else {
        rawNum = rawNum.replace(',', '.');
      }

      let val = parseFloat(rawNum) || 0;
      if (/\bmil\b/.test(s) && val > 0 && val < 100) {
        val *= 1000;
      }
      return val;
    }

    function findAccountMentionInText(rawText) {
      const norm = normalizeStr(rawText);
      if (!norm) return null;

      let bestAcc = null;
      let bestScore = 0;
      const ignoredWords = ['cuenta', 'mis', 'los', 'las', 'del', 'con', 'por', 'para', 'una', 'caja'];

      state.accounts.forEach(acc => {
        const accNorm = normalizeStr(acc.name);
        if (norm.includes(accNorm)) {
          if (accNorm.length + 10 > bestScore) {
            bestScore = accNorm.length + 10;
            bestAcc = acc;
          }
        }
        const tokens = accNorm.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(t => t.length >= 3 && !ignoredWords.includes(t));
        let score = 0;
        tokens.forEach(tok => {
          const regex = new RegExp(`(^|[^a-z0-9])${tok}([^a-z0-9]|$)`, 'i');
          if (regex.test(norm)) score += tok.length;
        });
        if (score > bestScore) {
          bestScore = score;
          bestAcc = acc;
        }
      });
      if (bestAcc) return bestAcc;

      const cashPatterns = /\b(efectivo|billetera|cash|contado|en mano|plata en mano|monedero)\b/i;
      if (cashPatterns.test(norm)) {
        const cashAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === 'acc_cash' || /efectivo|billetera|cash|mano|monedero/i.test(normalizeStr(a.name)));
        if (cashAcc) return cashAcc;
      }

      const usdSavingPatterns = /\b(ahorro|ahorros|cuenta dolares|cuenta en dolares|cuenta usd|ahorro dolares)\b/i;
      if (usdSavingPatterns.test(norm)) {
        const usdAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === 'acc_usd' || a.currency === 'USD' || /ahorro|dolar|usd/i.test(normalizeStr(a.name)));
        if (usdAcc) return usdAcc;
      }

      const bankDebitPatterns = /\b(brou|debito|banco|tarjeta|cuenta brou)\b/i;
      if (bankDebitPatterns.test(norm)) {
        const bankAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === 'acc_uyu' || /brou|debito|banco/i.test(normalizeStr(a.name)));
        if (bankAcc) return bankAcc;
      }

      return null;
    }

    function resolveAccountForSegment(segText, fullText, isUSD) {
      const segMatch = findAccountMentionInText(segText);
      if (segMatch) return segMatch;

      if (ui.voiceTargetAccountId && ui.voiceTargetAccountId !== 'auto') {
        const manualAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.id === ui.voiceTargetAccountId);
        if (manualAcc) return manualAcc;

      const globalMatch = findAccountMentionInText(fullText);
      if (globalMatch) return globalMatch;

      if (isUSD) {
        const usdAcc = state.accounts.find(a => a.currency === 'USD');
        if (usdAcc) return usdAcc;
      }

      return state.accounts[0];
    }

      let cleaned = rawTitle;
      state.accounts.forEach(acc => {
        const parts = acc.name.split(/[\/\-,()]+/).map(p => p.trim()).filter(p => p.length >= 3);
        parts.forEach(part => {
          const escaped = part.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
          const rx = new RegExp(`\\b(con|en|de|desde|por|a|en la|de la|con la|en el|del|al)?\\s*(cuenta\\s+)?${escaped}\\b`, 'gi');
          cleaned = cleaned.replace(rx, ' ');
        });
      });

      cleaned = cleaned
        .replace(/\b(con|en|de|desde|por|a)?\s*(la\s+|el\s+|mi\s+)?(cuenta\s+)?(efectivo|billetera|cash|contado|en mano|monedero|brou|debito|débito|banco|tarjeta de debito|tarjeta|ahorro dolares|ahorro en dolares|ahorro|cuenta en dolares|cuenta dolares)\b/gi, ' ')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .replace(/^[.,;:\-\s]+|[.,;:\-\s]+$/g, '')
        .trim();
      return cleaned;
    }

        let cleanTitle = seg
          .replace(/^(hey\s+gemini|gemini|krono)[,\s]*/i, '')
          .replace(/(\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{3})+(?:,\d+)?|\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*(mil)?/gi, ' ')
          .replace(/\b(un mil|dos mil|tres mil|cuatro mil|cinco mil|diez mil|quince mil|veinte mil|quinientos|seiscientos|setecientos|ochocientos|novecientos|cien|doscientos|trescientos|cuatrocientos|mil)\b/gi, ' ')
          .replace(/\b(gasté|gaste|pagué|pague|compré|compre|cobré|cobre|recibí|recibi|ingresé|ingrese|cargué|cargue|agregué|agregue|agrega|agregar|carga|cargar|anota|anotar|poné|pone|movimiento|gasto|ingreso|en|de|por|con|desde|pesos|dólares|dolares|dolar|dólar|usd|uyu)\b/gi, ' ');

              <h3 class="text-base font-extrabold text-white">${ui.isListening ? 'Escuchando tu voz...' : 'Dictado por Voz Gemini'}</h3>
              ${ui.voiceHintMsg ? `<p class="text-[11px] text-amber-200 bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-400/30 rounded-xl p-2">${ui.voiceHintMsg}</p>` : ''}
              <input id="voice-overlay-manual-input" type="text" value="${ui.voiceTranscript || ''}" oninput="ui.voiceTranscript=this.value;" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){submitVoiceOverlayInput();}" placeholder="Tocá aquí y usá el micrófono 🎙️ del teclado..." class="w-full bg-slate-950/85 border border-cyan-400/50 rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-3 text-xs text-white placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none" />
              <div class="w-full">
                <select onchange="ui.voiceTargetAccountId=this.value;" class="w-full max-w-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-cyan-200 font-bold truncate">
                  <option value="auto" ${ui.voiceTargetAccountId === 'auto' ? 'selected' : ''}>🤖 Cuenta: Auto-detectar por voz</option>
                  ${state.accounts.map(a => `<option value="${a.id}" ${ui.voiceTargetAccountId === a.id ? 'selected' : ''}>${a.icon || '🏦'} ${a.name}</option>`).join('')}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 w-full pt-1">
                <button onclick="submitVoiceOverlayInput()" class="spring-btn w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-400 text-slate-950 font-extrabold text-xs">
                  ✅ Procesar
                </button>
                <button onclick="stopVoiceCapture();ui.showVoiceWidgetOverlay=false;render();" class="w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 text-slate-300 font-bold text-xs">
                  Cerrar
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ` : ''}
      `;
    }
  </script>
</body></html>
